lf-file-editor.description: An editor that saves one bound UTF-8 file on the machine serving the page as the user types. The file lives outside Leaf's event log.
lf-file-editor.x-instructions: Write the element empty, and bind its `binding` to a real file with `leaf file bind PAGE BINDING PATH`. Tell the reader that edits save automatically; the editor reports slow saves, errors and conflicts itself. A page without the local binding shows the editor as unavailable, so use `lf-code` when the reader needs a copy of the file that travels with the page.
